description: Spreads the channels of a polyphonic cable evenly across a stereo pair, panning each channel at constant power

params.text: Sets how wide the channels are spread: at 100% channel 1 is hard left, the last channel hard right and the rest evenly spaced between them; at 0% every channel is centred
Scales both outputs, silent at 0% and unity at 100%; the taper is steep, 50% passing an eighth of the input

inputs.text: The polyphonic cable to be spread, its channel count setting how many positions the spread is divided into
Added to the channel of IN L with the same number before the spread, both then halved; nothing patched here is panned on its own, despite the panel printing IN R

outputs.text: The left side of the spread, polyphonic with one channel per input channel, unless Merge Poly Output sums them onto a single channel
The right side of the spread, polyphonic with one channel per input channel, unless Merge Poly Output sums them onto a single channel

menu: Merge Poly Output — sums the spread channels down to one channel on each output, making OUT L and OUT R a monophonic stereo pair; it is off until it is switched on
